Lee (release): FYI scheduling a small staged rollout in the 00:30 UTC change window. Pieces: API route pin v2.1.1, runtime quant-kernel v3, console opt-in toggle, router header-split. Need pins + rollback plan. @deploy-bot queue?

deploy-bot: Queued: wave rw-1768800000 for 2026-03-22T00:30:00Z. Preflight at 00:00 UTC. Use `/deploy status rw-1768800000`.

Cam (api): API pinned to v2.1.1 on canary. Fallback route prepared to v2.0.9. Patch snippet: `PATCH /routes/canary -d '{"target":"v2.0.9"}'`

Ravi (runtime): Runtime: quant-kernel v3 in canary pool. Expect ~6% memory bump during warmup. Canary left for 20m before widening. Watch `runtime.mem.usage` and `kernel.warmup.ms`.

Isla (console): Console toggle `schemaStrict` will remain OFF by default. I added a manual flip in release UI. Rollback steps noted in runbook.

Nina (router): Router will do 5% -> 25% -> 75% with 12m holds. Header added: `X-Rw-Canary: true`. Note: cache miss spike possible for first 10m.

Lee (release): Rollback criteria proposal: sustained 10m error-rate >0.5% OR p95 increase >30ms OR any canary OOM. @Omar confirm?

Omar (oncall): Confirm. Also trigger if model backend 5xx spike >0.4% in 5m. I'll be watching and will post ROLLBACK if thresholds hit.

Ravi (runtime): Fallback command if needed: `runtime rollback --wave rw-1768800000 --to quant-v2`

Cam (api): API rollback: unpin canary and purge keys: `curl -XPOST https://api.internal/purge -d 'routes=canary'`

Lee (release): TL;DR preflight 00:00 UTC, final GO/NO-GO 00:18 UTC, rollout 00:30 UTC. Be on #release-watch. I'll post preflight results here.

deploy-bot: Dry-run passed. Preflight scheduled. Logs will stream here.
